name: Madame Ghede
source:
The local medicine woman and a friend of Cinders' late mother. The townsfolk think of her as a witch and generally mistrust her, but are all too willing to run to her when they need help, a fact she resents greatly and which hurts her more than she cares to let on.

Cinders' relationship with her depends on the player's choices.
